official.domain-heading: Ofitsiini saity GFTV zakinchuiutsia na globalfurry.tv abo gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Chytaite adresu z kintsia: dyvitsia na ostanniu krapku pered pershoiu odynarnoiu skisnoiu ryskoiu. Sait, shcho zakinchuietsia chymos inshym, ne nalezhyt GFTV, navit yakshcho tsia nazva trapliaietsia v adresi ranishe.
official.secure-body: Shukaite znachok zamka abo https:// na pochatku adresy. Povidomliaite osobysti dani lyshe na ofitsiinomu saiti cherez zakhyshchene ziednannia.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) — naibilshyi novynnyi kanal furi-fendomu v Azii, shcho bazuietsia v Sinhapuri.
about.body-2: My pokazuiemo, yak zrostaie furi-spilnota, shchob kozhen mih otsinyty tse sohodni y zavtra, i stvoriuiemo prostory, de liudy mozhut piznaty y zrozumity odne odnoho.
about.body-3: Komanda GFTV, shcho z ridnoho domu okhopliuie naibilshi kontynenty, — mizhnarodna, bahatokulturna y bahatomovna.
